get_path_for_cmu: get the path to the CMU mocap HDF5 data file, downloading it if not already cached
download_cmu_mocap_data: download the CMU motion capture data file into a local cache directory with progress bar
validate_cached_file: check if a cached CMU mocap data file exists and has the correct file size
verify_download_hash: verify the SHA256 hash of a downloaded CMU mocap data file to ensure integrity
summarize_cmu_mocap_constants: summarize the CMU mocap data constants including filenames, URLs, expected sizes, and SHA256 hashes
